page.layout: One printed page: a full-page engraved plate of a celestial projection (a two-lobed zodiac diagram with signs and a central mark), with calligraphic inscriptions in the upper left and upper right corners. Below the plate, faint lines of script are visible but unreadable, probably show-through. A strip of the facing page's text runs along the left edge, which is not part of this page.
page.notes: No page number, running head or signature is printed. The plate's upper-right inscription reads "CIↃ.IↃ.CXXIX." (MDCXXIX). The lower-centre faint script is illegible. The left-edge fragments belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. The diagram itself, with zodiac signs (Aries/Taurus-type symbols, Cancer, Libra, Capricorn, Pisces and others) and the letter D, is not text and is only described here.
